_comment: OPF33 V1.1 (STM32F407ZGT7) Speeduino board definition. Pins from config/opf33/board.yaml (33-pin V1.1 map: CLT PC5, IAT PB0, TPS PA7, MAP PA3, AFR PA4, trigger Hall PG1, inj PD13-PD10, ign PE15-PE12, aux PD9-PD6, tacho PD14). Consumed by scripts/speeduino/build_speeduino.sh.
name: opf33
pin_notes: V1.1 33-pin map. Primary trigger default is Hall on connector pin 8 (PG1) via JP4; VR plus is PE2 and is not the Speeduino default.
On-board MAP is PA3 (MPXHZ6400). On-board 14point7 wideband linear output is PA4 (pinO2). Battery sense is PB1.
CLT/IAT on PC5/PB0 have permanent 2.49 k pull-ups (R85/R86). TPS is PA7 with no pull-up.
V1.1 has no CAN2, DBW/ETB, EGT, stepper or knock hardware. Those Speeduino pin vars are left unused (PB2).
Secondary trigger (PE9/PE8, JP5/JP6) is unused in the default map.
On-board barometer is LPS25HB on I2C PB10/PB11 (not LPS22HH). Status LEDs match the rusEFI/FOME overlay; the error LED is PE3.
OPF33 has an SD card on SPI3 (PC10-12, CS PB3) and no W25Q SPI flash; OPF_SPI_FLASH_* is left unset so Speeduino does not enable USE_SPI_EEPROM on those pins.
